rubricDefinitions.score0: Observed submitted result is unusable or contradicts the assigned task. Missing evidence is NOT_ASSESSED.
rubricDefinitions.score1: Major errors prevent the main task from succeeding.
rubricDefinitions.score2: Main path works; material edge cases or constraints remain unresolved.
rubricDefinitions.score3: Agreed main, boundary and failure checks pass; only minor non-blocking issues remain.
rubricDefinitions.score4: All agreed checks pass and additional justified checks support robust correctness.
rubricDefinitions.evidenceRule: Artifact and expected/actual checks tied to the assigned skill task.

rubricDefinitions.score0: Submitted verification is inspectable, but its checks are invalid or do not test the claimed behaviour.
rubricDefinitions.score1: Claims rely on unrepeatable or incomplete demonstrations.
rubricDefinitions.score2: Main-path evidence is repeatable; important failure cases or provenance are missing.
rubricDefinitions.score3: Evidence is reproducible and covers agreed boundary/failure cases with traceable inputs.
rubricDefinitions.score4: Evidence is reproducible, risk-based and includes independent cross-checks plus explicit limitations.
rubricDefinitions.evidenceRule: Inputs, method, outputs, logs and relevant failure/boundary cases.

rubricDefinitions.score0: Cannot perform the task even with the permitted support.
rubricDefinitions.score1: Needs substantial support beyond the level allowance.
rubricDefinitions.score2: Completes most work within the allowance, but needs extra corrective intervention.
rubricDefinitions.score3: Completes the agreed scope within the level allowance and escalates justified uncertainties.
rubricDefinitions.score4: Meets level allowance throughout; anticipates and resolves relevant issues without extra corrective help.
rubricDefinitions.evidenceRule: Record assessor interventions and distinguish permitted guidance from corrective help.

rubricDefinitions.score0: Cannot explain the work or its purpose.
rubricDefinitions.score1: Explanation misses key decisions or contradicts the evidence.
rubricDefinitions.score2: Explains main steps but misses a material assumption, limitation or alternative.
rubricDefinitions.score3: Explains decisions, assumptions and limitations with evidence at the assigned level.
rubricDefinitions.score4: Defends decisions against relevant alternatives and incorporates review feedback with evidence.
rubricDefinitions.evidenceRule: Written or oral rationale linked to artifacts and the assigned level.

rubricDefinitions.score0: An inspectable attempt fails to demonstrate the required foundation.
rubricDefinitions.score1: Major mistakes invalidate the foundation behaviour.
rubricDefinitions.score2: Demonstrates the main behaviour but a material required condition fails.
rubricDefinitions.score3: Demonstrates every required foundation condition on the supplied bounded scenario.
rubricDefinitions.score4: Demonstrates the foundation and handles a relevant counterexample correctly.
rubricDefinitions.evidenceRule: Artifact or demonstration showing the readinessOutcome on the supplied scenario.

rubricDefinitions.score0: Submitted checks are inspectable but invalid.
rubricDefinitions.score1: Checks are mostly assertions without reproducible comparisons.
rubricDefinitions.score2: A valid main-case check is provided but a required counterexample or trace is missing.
rubricDefinitions.score3: Expected and observed results can be reproduced for the main case and counterexample.
rubricDefinitions.score4: Independent checks corroborate the result and explain limitations.
rubricDefinitions.evidenceRule: Inputs, expected and observed results, and repeatable verification steps.

rubricDefinitions.score0: An observed explanation contradicts the demonstrated behaviour.
rubricDefinitions.score2: Explains the main behaviour but misses a relevant assumption.
rubricDefinitions.score3: Explains why the foundation is needed and one limitation.
rubricDefinitions.score4: Explains the dependency, a counterexample and the consequence of a violated assumption.
rubricDefinitions.evidenceRule: A short written or recorded explanation tied to the evidence.
